headline: JPMorgan Downgrades Alstom Following Profit Warning
summary: JPMorgan downgraded its stock rating for Alstom following a profit warning issued by the company.
why: Analyst downgrades and profit warnings typically trigger downward pressure on equity prices as market participants re-evaluate earnings projections and corporate execution risks.

impacts.name: Alstom
impacts.why: A profit warning and subsequent analyst downgrade directly reduce equity valuation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A lowered earnings outlook prompted JPMorgan to downgrade the stock, depressing its market value.
